body:
## 0.6.0 - 2026-11-13

- Combine active CSS into one content-addressed stylesheet per frontend, admin, or login context.
- Enqueue the same frontend bundle on the site and in the block editor instead of printing inline CSS.
- Publish bundles atomically with cache-safe filenames and preserve the last working bundle or inline fallback after a failed rebuild.
- Preserve legacy snippet ordering while moving frontend CSS delivery to the document head.
